objective: Provide a revision-bound terminal interaction for AR discussion, decision, and conflict reconciliation.
assumptions: Coordinator owns AR identity and revisions
The TUI is a downstream client
unknowns: Terminal renderer toolkit and transport adapter
invariants: Every input and output binds to project, AR, revision, and packet digest
No stale or cross-point response is accepted
Safe exit persists all points and future requests
Unresolved contradictions require targeted reopen and another discussion
TUI output never claims implementation correctness
acceptance_predicates: Stale, skipped-gate, cross-point, dropped-request, and silent-conflict traces fail closed
